_trace.query: custom agent subagent allowlist not enforced restricted agents can invoke any subagent
_trace.looking_for: an issue reporting that a custom agent with a restricted/limited allowed-subagents list can still invoke agents outside that list via runSubagent, i.e. the allowlist frontmatter is ignored/not enforced

_trace.why: Issue 331002 directly describes the agents: frontmatter allowlist being parsed but not enforced by RunSubagentTool, matching the vulnerability described.

_trace.action: read the real source and judged
_trace.why: The diff adds validateSubagentAllowed(), called in prepareToolInvocation before subagent lookup and (per the diff hunk) in invoke() before dispatch, throwing when allowedSubagents exists and excludes the requested name; it also fixes allowedSubagents: subagent.agents (was undefined) so nested modeInstructions preserve the subagent's own allowlist, and threads modeInstructions?.allowedSubagents into ComputeAutomaticInstructions. However, the provided 'current contents' snapshot still shows the pre-patch invoke() (no validateSubagentAllowed call, allowedSubagents: undefined), so the file as shown doesn't yet reflect the diff — it's unclear if this snapshot is stale or the patch wasn't actually applied.
